item.title: CLI Reference
item.description: CLI Reference The gorai command-line tool provides utilities for development and deployment. Commands gorai init Create a new Gorai project: 1 gorai init <project-name> gorai run Run a Gorai application: 1 gorai run [--config config.yaml] gorai build Build for deployment: 1 gorai build [--target linux/arm64] gorai version Show version information: 1 gorai version Global Flags Flag Description --config Configuration file path --log-level Log level (debug, info, warn, error) --nats-url NATS server URL
